True from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    sep = len(grid[0]) // 2
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    left_bg = Counter(x for row in left for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg = Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    left_fg = next(x for x, _ in Counter(x for row in left for x in row).most_common() if x != left_bg)
    right_fg = next(x for x, _ in Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common() if x != right_bg)

    if right_fg == 0:
        base, mark = right_bg, 3
        active = lambda r, c: left[r][c] == left_fg and right[r][c] != right_fg
    elif left_fg == 9:
        base, mark = left_bg, 3
        active = lambda r, c: right[r][c] == right_fg and left[r][c] != left_fg
    else:
        base, mark = 3, 2
        active = lambda r, c: left[r][c] == left_fg or right[r][c] == right_fg

    return [[mark if active(r, c) else base for c in range(len(left[r]))]
            for r in range(len(grid))]
